#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generator specialized in reordered completions (superseded feedback)."""
import random

def make(rng):
    C = 2
    W = rng.randint(1, 3)
    K = rng.randint(1, W)
    E = 1
    F = 1
    lanes = rng.randint(2, 4)
    svc = [rng.choice([1, 2, 3]), rng.choice([50, 200, 1000])]
    rng.shuffle(svc)
    S = rng.choice([1, 2])
    nconn = rng.randint(1, 3)
    conns = [{"id": "x%d" % i, "slot": rng.randrange(S), "label": rng.randrange(C),
              "split": rng.choice(["dev", "eval"])} for i in range(nconn)]
    bucket = rng.randint(2, 8)
    cfg = {"slots": S, "window": W, "idle_timeout": rng.choice([50, 1000, 10**6]),
           "len_quantum": 1, "gap_quantum": 1,
           "rate_num": rng.choice([1, 5, 100]), "rate_den": rng.choice([1, 2, 3]),
           "bucket_capacity": bucket, "initial_tokens": rng.randint(0, bucket),
           "pending_capacity": rng.choice([2, 4, 512]), "lanes": lanes,
           "service": svc, "fallback": rng.randrange(C),
           "time_edges": [0], "count_edges": [0], "probability": [[65536]]}
    # prediction depends on parity of the length bin so service times alternate
    emb = [[0 if a % 2 == 0 else 10] for a in range(16)]
    mdl = {"classes": C, "embedding_dim": E, "length_embedding": emb,
           "gap_embedding": [[0] for _ in range(16)], "kernel": K,
           "conv_weights": [[[1, 0]] for _ in range(K)], "conv_bias": [0],
           "conv_shift": [0], "dense_weights": [[1], [-1]], "dense_bias": [0, 0]}
    pkts = []
    t = 0
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 50)):
        t += rng.choice([0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 7, 100, 1000])
        pkts.append({"time": t, "connection": rng.choice(conns)["id"],
                     "length": rng.randrange(32), "draw": 0})
    return {"version": 1, "config": cfg, "model": mdl, "connections": conns, "packets": pkts}
PYEOF
